review_scope: Complete Chinese–English alignment read including title and deck. Complete existing text retained with eight local corrections awaiting independent review. The cosmological proposal and its if-they-exist qualification are preserved as the author's argument, not externally validated astronomy.

changes.before: The first essay opened with a line: this one was not written because anyone wanted to write it.
changes.after: The first essay opened with a line: I did not particularly want to write this piece.
changes.reason: Restore the author's qualified first-person reluctance rather than the added universal nobody wanted it.

changes.before: So the act of writing this is itself a demonstration of the structure it describes: nobody particularly wanted to, the direction was clear, and now it steps aside.
changes.after: So the act of writing this is itself a demonstration of the structure it describes: not particularly wanting to do it, but clear about the direction, and stepping aside once it is done.
changes.reason: Restore the act's qualified reluctance without speaking for everyone.

changes.before: attacking strategy → attacking through disputation → attacking one's own thought → not attacking at all → having no arms.
changes.after: the highest use of arms attacks strategy → arms transcended attack through disputation → arms at the limit attack one's own thought → arms grown mysterious do not attack → the sage has no arms.
changes.reason: Restore the five named levels using their existing definitions in ep02, instead of reducing them to bare verbs.

changes.before: 4. A Civilization That Reaches the End Grows Quieter
changes.after: 4. A Civilization That Reaches the End Becomes More Hidden
changes.reason: Restore the visibility claim 更隐 in the heading; the separate quiet-universe motif remains elsewhere.

changes.before: This is not unwillingness to deal with lower civilizations. It is structural non-encounter. What the ascended can offer, the ascending cannot yet receive; what the ascending can provoke, the ascended processed long ago. The two depths of cultivation do not match structurally — much as ultrasound is not refusing to be heard by human ears, it is simply outside the range those ears cover.
changes.after: This is not unwillingness to deal with lower civilizations. It is structural non-encounter. What civilizations moving upward can offer, civilizations moving downward cannot yet receive; what those moving downward can provoke, those moving upward processed long ago. The two depths of cultivation do not match structurally — much as ultrasound is not refusing to be heard by human ears, it is simply outside the range those ears cover.
changes.reason: The source says 上行/下行, not already ascended/still ascending. Retain the author's directional terminology and flag its possible intended level reading rather than silently repair it.

changes.before: We do not see them because they died, or hid, or were swept away by something higher.
changes.after: It is not because they have died, because they are hiding, or because advanced civilizations have eliminated less advanced ones that we cannot see them.
changes.reason: Disambiguate the scope of all three negations. The old wording can wrongly imply that their deaths explain why we cannot see them.

changes.before: What does it consist of? Understanding that cultivation is a civilization's real home ground. Not conquest, not expansion, not victory, not being technologically stronger, larger, more present. A civilization's real home ground is the process by which subjects deepen, unfold, and grow into one another.
changes.after: What does it consist of? Understanding that cultivation is a civilization's real home ground. Not conquest, not expansion, not victory, not being technologically stronger, larger, more present. A civilization's real home ground is the process by which subjects continually deepen, unfold, and grow through one another.
changes.reason: Restore sustained mutual growth without implying fusion into each other.

changes.before: To those civilizations already waiting, hidden within the cosmos, if they exist. To everyone who died in a war without a language available for stating their own standing as a carrier of cultivation. To those not yet born, who will face the collisions of their own time — challenges we cannot imagine now, but at least with a direction to face.
changes.after: To those civilizations already waiting, hidden within the cosmos, if they exist. To everyone who died in a war without a language available for stating their own standing as a subject of cultivation. To those not yet born, who will face the collisions of their own time — challenges we cannot imagine now, but at least with a direction to face.
changes.reason: Restore 涵育主体 rather than replacing subject with carrier.

unresolved_source_questions.finding: Source 上行/下行 could be a directional contrast or intended higher/lower-level contrast. Existing English silently turns the latter side into still-ascending civilizations. Proposed translation follows the actual direction words pending author clarification.

metadata_changes.before: Finish, then step aside, and hand attention back to cultivation. A civilization that walks the sequence to its end grows quieter, not louder — so the silence of the universe asks not where they are, but where we are.
metadata_changes.after: Finish, then step aside, and hand attention back to cultivation. A civilization that walks the sequence to its end becomes more hidden, not more conspicuous — so the silence of the universe asks not where they are, but where we are.
metadata_changes.reason: Restore visibility, not sound, in the civilization claim.
